  Set up auto mode for your environment?
  Auto mode lets Claude act without asking first. Telling it which repos you trust and what data is sensitive makes that safer. Claude will explore your
  repo and recent sessions, then check its draft with you — takes a few minutes, and you can keep working in another terminal while it runs.
  ❯ 1. Set it up
    2. Not now
    3. Don't show again
  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
